pullRequest.title: Harden diff-only code review prompts
pullRequest.body:
Fixes #82.

What changed:
- Make the code review template explicitly treat diff-only context as partial evidence and forbid confident claims about code outside the shown hunk without further inspection.
- Load builtin template YAML as UTF-8 so reviews work reliably on Windows.
- Add regression coverage for both behaviors.

Validation:
- uv run pytest tests/review/test_builtin_code.py
- uv run ruff check src/squadron/review/builders/code.py src/squadron/review/templates/__init__.py tests/review/test_builtin_code.py
- uv run ruff format --check src/squadron/review/builders/code.py src/squadron/review/templates/__init__.py tests/review/test_builtin_code.py
